pages.title: Description
pages.text: In this ritual a $(#ad03fc)Foliot$() is summoned $(bold)as a familiar$(), the slaughter of a $(#ad03fc)Chicken$() and the offering of dyes are intended to entice the $(#ad03fc)Foliot$() to take the shape of a parrot.$(br)As $(#ad03fc)Foliot$() are not among the smartest spirits, they sometimes $()
*This means, if a $(#ad03fc)Chicken$() is spawned, that's not a bug, just bad luck!*$(br2)$(bold)Upgrade Behaviour$()$(br)Cannot be upgraded by the blacksmith familiar.$(br)
